description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lingering Tormentor.
When Lingering Tormentor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lingering Tormentor.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
